description: R001 game features — install per-feature via EZG Feature Hub.
$comment: Authored metadata per feature, keyed '<Category>/<Name>'. Wins over anything derived
from the .unitypackage. markerPaths = what Feature Hub deletes on uninstall, so it must
name the feature's own folder(s) and never a container like Assets/_Project.
requires = other features in THIS project's catalog; requiresPackages = UPM id -> version.

LiveOps/SevenDay.description: 7-day login event (daily quest + reward chest + IAP pack). KHÔNG self-contained ở mức compile: cần project đích đã có sẵn LiveOps/Quest, Meta/WorldMap và Monetization/Shop (game-specific, chưa publish lên hub) — feature này không khai requires vì catalog R001 chưa có 3 feature đó.
